name: Stéphane Passet
findings: Within his own canvases, light grape green turns up as a small accent in 40% of the paintings that hold it, 6.5x the archive's rate (from 623 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, dusty rose brown turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.1x the archive's rate (from 623 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, bronze turns up as the shadow in 77% of the paintings that hold it, 3.1x the archive's rate (from 623 paintings here).
Pairs light brown with pale flesh more than chance would predict (3 of 623 paintings here).
Pairs chocolate brown with dusty rose brown more than chance would predict (4 of 623 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (dark olive brown, platinum, smoky black) covers 68% of his paintings here.
